support.description: How to update the app and check problems after an update.
support.title: Update support
support.app_intro: Lite.9 and later can update from the app. You can also check from the menu if no notification appears.
support.app_step1: Choose it from the steamac Lite menu at the top of the Mac screen. Use the Mac app menu, rather than the Steam menu inside SteamOS.
support.app_step2: When a new version is shown, choose Update. Wait for the download and file verification to finish.
support.app_step3: Save anything you need in the game first. The app waits for SteamOS to shut down, replaces the app, and opens the new version.
support.keep_title: Your disk and games are kept
support.keep: The update replaces the Mac app. Your SteamOS disk, installed games, and existing settings are kept. You do not need to create a new disk to update.
support.dmg_intro: Use these steps for Lite.8 or earlier, or if the app will not open.
support.dmg_step1_title: Quit steamac Lite if it is running
support.dmg_step1: Save anything you need in the game, then quit steamac Lite. If it is shutting down, wait for that to finish.
support.dmg_step2: Use the button below to download the Mac DMG. Source code on GitHub is for development.
support.dmg_step3: Open the DMG, then open SteamAC Lite.app inside it. When prompted, choose Install and Open to replace the installed app with the new version.
support.dmg_caption: Example installation prompt. Choose Install and Open.
support.booth: The BOOTH online installer also downloads the latest app. Select the folder containing your existing app as the destination.
support.mic_intro: From Lite.13, a microphone check appears on first launch and the first launch after each update, including when access is already allowed.
support.mic_unknown: Choose Allow Microphone… and allow access in the macOS dialog when it appears. Choose Later if you do not want to request access now.
support.mic_allowed: The app shows that microphone access is allowed. Choose Continue.
support.mic_denied: Choose Open Microphone Settings… and check permission for this app. If access is restricted by an administrator, contact that administrator.
support.mic_os: The app check and the macOS permission dialog are separate. macOS decides whether its permission dialog appears.
support.mic_check_title: If there is still no input
support.mic_check1: In System Settings → Sound → Input on the Mac, select your microphone and check whether the input level moves. steamac Lite uses the Mac's default input device.
support.mic_check2: In System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, check access for steamac Lite. If it stopped working after an update, try turning this app's permission off and on again, even if it is already on.
support.mic_check3: In steamac Lite, open Settings → Sound and choose Check Again. Also check the Steam microphone test and the input device selected in VRChat.
support.mic_limit: After you dismiss the check, it does not appear again for the same version. You can check access at any time in Settings → Sound.
support.trouble_notice: Use steamac Lite → Check for Updates… to check manually. Automatic checks can be up to six hours apart. You can use the menu even if you skipped a version. Lite.8 and earlier need the DMG method.
support.trouble_download: Check your connection and free space on the Mac, then try again. If it still fails, quit the running app and use the DMG method. If verification errors continue, include the displayed error when asking for help.
support.trouble_launch_title: The updated app will not open
support.trouble_launch: Open the latest DMG and use the app installed in Applications. If macOS asks to confirm opening it, check the source and follow the on-screen instructions. If it still will not open, send the details listed below.
support.contact_intro: Send the details below, as far as you know them, through GitHub Issues or BOOTH.
support.contact_mac: Mac model, memory, and macOS version
support.contact_version: App versions before and after updating
support.contact_route: Whether you used in-app update, a GitHub DMG, or BOOTH
support.contact_error: Where it stops, any error text, and a screenshot if possible
support.contact_mic: For microphone problems: built-in, USB, Bluetooth, etc., and whether the Mac input meter moves
